# Vanta Tweaks

> Windows apps that tune a gaming PC: BIOS Tuner and Core Tuner, plus the free Latency Lab, which measures a game
> before and after any tweak.

## Apps

- [BIOS Tuner](https://vantatweaks.com/bios-tuner): reads all BIOS settings, including hidden ones, and tunes the ones that matter for gaming for your CPU and board, with three
  presets (Safe, Recommended, Max). Shows every change first, saves a backup and restores it in one click. Works on
  desktop PCs with an AMI BIOS (most ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte and ASRock boards), not on most laptops.
  Prices (EUR, VAT included): 1 month 8, 3 months 12, 1 year 20, lifetime 30. One key, one PC.
- [Core Tuner](https://vantatweaks.com/core-tuner): keeps a game's busiest threads on the fastest CPU cores while it
  runs. A small tray app with a list of your games; warns before boosting games with strict anti-cheat. Prices (EUR, VAT
  included): 1 month 5, 3 months 8, 1 year 12, lifetime 20. One key, one PC.
- [Latency Lab](https://vantatweaks.com/latency-lab): free. Measures a game before and after a tweak: FPS, 1% and 0.1%
  lows, PC latency, stutters, GPU temperature and clock, CPU speed and throttling. Changes nothing.
- Coming later: Windows Tuner, Network Tuner, GPU Tuner, game packs.
